releases.displayName: Small patch for a big outcome!

items.text: Hi gummies! 🍭
New tiny little thing to help with previous controllers issues:
We've updated the input system from XInput to use Windows Gaming Input, so now you don't have to deal with special configurations to use more than 4 Xbox controllers.

Hopefully those of you who used to meet with lots of friends and family to play A Gummy's Life will now only enjoy the fun of the game without worrying about your computers recognizing the controllers first.
Would love to hear your thoughts on this!
Remember, of if you don't know yet, have a look at the new coop adventure game we are developing:

releases.displayName: Tiny little patch for some freshness to the game!

items.text: Although our small team is currently working on developing a new game, our commitment with our previous games is still here and so we bring you a new tiny patch to offer some minor improvements to A Gummy's Life.
It might not look like much, but pay attention to the following list of
Improved network code to reduce latency, memory management and synchronization time
Your gummy character will turn towards the target when there's no input, so hitting your opponents effectively will be much easier. You asked for it, here you have it!
Improved screen settings behavior with more than one screen
Fixed an overpowered climbable wall in Arigatothewater map

A new profile will be created automatically when you open the game the first time with your Steam user (you can still change it afterwards, but we make sure you start collecting stats from the beginning!)
And that's not all, folks. Our gummies wardrobe of cool hats and glasses will be gone soon. A full new set of cosmetics will be available before this year ends.
Have you collected all your favorites so far? If not, go on and engage in online matchmaking battles to get those you're missing. They'll be gone soon!
We hope you guys have fun with friends and family playing A Gummy's Life <3 That's why we developed this game and you make us truly happy when you write to us to say things of the sort.
In case you didn't know, the other game we are currently developing is an online coop adventure game called Oppidum and we've also got its own Discord server opened
See you soon!
EP Games Team

It's been a while since we brought you the Altar update, and, while we haven't stopped bringing you awesome events and celebrations, we've also been working very hard to be able to bring you a brand new patch with some special spooky features, just in time to celebrate the creepiest time of the year! Hope you like them!
Randomized gummies used to lose their cosmetics before the game, now they will stay glued on unless your gummy gets hit too hard.
Gummies' feet used to bug on BeeCareful tiles, stopping the floor from falling, but all gummies are now doomed to fall.
Scores for King of the Hill mode when playing online with 3 or more players showed the wrong number, for this patch we've learned to count.
After dying online in Grousky, controllers would keep vibrating even after the player's death, we've gone a more eco-friendly route and we've decided to make it stop, to save energy.

Bored of dying the first in every match and just watching? Don't worry! Enable the new option "Afterlife" in your match customization (local or private) and improve your abilities while your friends keep fighting for victory! After you die in a match, your gummy will still appear as a playable character in the map in the form of a ghost! Spook everyone with your abilities!

On another note, for those looking for a bigger challenge, how about using a ball or a barrel to get a point? Join a match in King of The Hill mode and throw one of the items into a marshmallow for a point, now with style!
Also, gummies' juices splattered onto cars will start falling slowly, instead of disappearing, little by little, for some dramatic added effects!
And, finally, a fun surprise: when an AI wins a match, if any cosmetics are left around the battlefield, it will try to pick them up and equip them!

We hope you guys have been enjoying the game lately and keep doing so with these new cool features and fixes! If you find any issues, remember you can always reach us on our social media ( Twitter , Instagram or Facebook ) or go to the discussion forums . You can also join us on Discord to talk about the game or schedule a match with someone from your region ;)
Also remember that your reviews are very important to us and help us a lot! ❤ See you playing!
EP Games Team

releases.displayName: Official Reveal Trailer - A Gummy's Life huge update coming September 24th

notes.title: The long awaited release date announcement has come!

items.text: You'll all be able to enjoy the new version of A Gummy's Life, with new unlockable gummies, new maps, unlockable cosmetics and more on September 24th!!

notes.title: We're always active & in touch with the community, so we'll try to solve any issues you might find while playing A Gummy's Life.

items.text: If you ever find any issues or bugs, please contact us on support@epgames.eu or on Discord

AIs used to take control over the player's gummy in rare cases of a bit of lag detected; we have a system to ensure other players can still play if one loses connection, but hey, a bit of lag should not make you lose your character!
Gummies would get stuck in the online hub if they got out & in of a game very quickly; we explained to them how agile humans are and they'll handle it better from now on.
Fixed an issue with the internal clock synchronization in online mode that caused, on some ocassions, that other players were not seen moving.
Sudden death after a draw at the end of an online game was not working, but there can only be one champion!
Remaping the keyboard controls was not working properly.

notes.title: We hope you guys like it.

items.text: Enjoy and don't forget to leave your thoughts on the discussion forums!

You can unlock the Egg again, an evil bug made it impossible, sorry!

Fixed some rare cases with the pause menu.
We hope you guys like it.
Enjoy and don't forget to leave your thoughts on the discussion forums!

notes.title: Hello! the time has come. Online multiplayer has arrived to A Gummy's Life.

items.text: Fellow A Gummy's Life players, we are proud to announce that Online multiplayer is here.

Many of you were asking since the early access release that we should add online multiplayer to A Gummy's Life, we wanted to do it as well but since it's a physics-based game, making it work with no problems it's hard. But it's here, it works, IT'S FUN, trust us.
Currently there's only Deathmatch mode and 8 levels. We will be adding more levels in the following weeks.
To play it you just have to press the big Online button in the main menu. We have replaced the training button, which is now available in the top right corner of the main menu.
Added Online multiplayer.
Added TheRolling to the online mode.
Several fixes in the online mode based on the online beta feedback.
Added a ping restriction when connecting to Online multiplayer.
Added ping lock in the online mode (To prevent people with high ping to disturb other people games)
If a player disconnects mid-game in online multiplayer it will become an AI.
If the master host leaves the game, other player may become the new host (The current level will reset)
Upgraded the game engine version.
Big improvements on how the game controls are shown to the player.
Revised the anticipation times of several attacks, everything should be faster now.
Overall improvements in the controls.
AI now is able to grab and throw you.
Added hit particles to improve the hitting feeling.
Various AI improvements.
Various UI animation improvements.
First profile is now autoselected when selecting a character.
Added more robots in Robox.
King of Hill gummy roll can no longer appear over obstacles.
Robox updated. Doors will now open when there's an knock-out gummy close, and doors will now absorb you instead of making you explode (you still die :P).
Fixed the camera on Training sometimes flying away.
Various improvements in how the gummies behave when the buildings go up in Grousky.
Black fog bug on Arigatothewater is now fixed! yay!: And as always more little bug fixes that may be unnoticed by you, but not to us :)
Bring your friends from all over the world and come join the fun.
We hope you guys like it.
Enjoy and don't forget to let your thoughts on the discussion forums!

releases.displayName: A Gummy's Life 0.90beta - Online beta is here!

notes.title: Hello! the Online beta is here, come help us improve it by participating :D

items.text: Fellow A Gummy's Life players, the time has come. After a few months developing it, we are ready to release the first beta of the Online multiplayer version of A Gummy's Life.
How to Opt-in?

Since this is a beta release you need to enter this code: "AGLO20182018" into the beta's tab, to do so follow this steps: Right click A Gummy's Life on Steam > Properties > Beta tab > Add code in the field > Select "onlinebeta" in the dropdown > Accept and download the new version!
Beta? What does this mean?

Since making online multiplayer for this physics-based action game is very hard, we want to reach the end users with the best version that we can deliver them.: This mean that the current state is a Beta version where we would be hearing your thoughts and feedback to improve this version before releasing it to everyone.
How can we, the users. help you?
We would love to hear your feedback in our discussion forums, call your friends, test everything, break it if you can, but tell us how, we'll fix it, we promise.
What is included in the online beta?
Currently there's only Deathmatch mode and 7 levels, we will be adding more levels in the following weeks.: Everything else is the same.
We also created a Discord server for you to join!
Added Online beta.
Revised the anticipation times of several attacks, everything should be faster now.
Overall improvements in the controls.
AI now is able to grab and throw you.
Added hit particles to improve the hitting feeling.
Various AI improvements.
Various UI animation improvements.
First profile is now autoselected when selecting a character.
Added more robots in Robox.
King of Hill gummy roll can no longer appear over obstacles.
Minor performance improvements.
Fixed the camera on Training sometimes flying away.
Black fog bug on Arigatothewater is now fixed! yay!
And as always more little bug fixes that may or may not be noticed by you, but we see them! :)
So... bring your friends and come join the fun.
We hope you guys like it.
Enjoy and don't forget to let your thoughts on the discussion forums!

notes.title: Hello! It's been a hard one, but here we are with another juicy update!

items.text: 3 New Game Modes avalaible.
Team Deathmatch - Wanted to play with a friend in the same team? Now you can! up to 4 teams fighting each other.
King of the Hill - Don't always fight, be tactical, conquer the zones faster than your opponents.
Hot Potato - It's hot, it's coming, pass the hot potato between your enemies so they explode, the last one standing wins!
2 New levels!
Robox - Escape the robots coming for you, fight with the boxes, don't let the conveyor belts get you!
Grousky - To the sky they say, fight and run, don't fall!
2 New unlockable characters, the Burger and the Cherry.
With the new way to unlock them, a new challenger aproaches! Fight the Big Gummy to unlock it, will you be able to defeat it?
A Gummy's Life now supports 6 new languages
Simplified Chinnese
Japanese
Russian
German
French.
and Portuguese!
Make fun on your opponents with the new taunt system, use your arrows/d-pad to use them!
Dab, Clap, Show your strenght or even thank your viewers for watching your show!
Levels will not appear twice in a row anymore if there's more selected in the map selection.
And as always more underground fixes that will make the game feel more polished.
Enjoy and don't forget to let your thoughts on the discussion forums!
